content:
Jordan: Heads-up — Acme (Priya) opened a ticket: several dashboard panels are returning empty frames and the console shows 500/504 when loading analytics queries since ~08:40 UTC. Happens on 'Sales Overview' and a few custom panels.
Priya (Acme Inc.): Yep, that's right. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/test/xxx. UI shows spinner then '500 Internal Server Error' or a timeout after ~30s. Blocking our exec review.
Jordan: Repro steps from customer: 1) Console -> Project: Acme 2) Open 'Sales Overview' dashboard 3) Panels using orders_per_minute / revenue_by_region fail when timeframe = Last 7 days. If timeframe = Last 1h some panels load.
Ethan: Can you paste a failing request headers or X-Request-Id from the network tab? That'll help trace to agg-querier/clickhouse.
Priya (Acme Inc.): From browser devtools:
```
POST /analytics/query HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwoodinference.com
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
X-Request-Id: a1b2c3d4-9f
Content-Type: application/json
```
Request body is large group-by + date_histogram, timeframe last_7d.
Jordan: Thanks — Ethan, can you grep logs for req=a1b2c3d4-9f and see upstream result?
Ethan: Found it. agg-querier logs show upstream timeout to clickhouse-proxy and connection pool exhaustion. Snippet: 
```
2026-03-16T08:41:12Z agg-querier ERROR req=a1b2c3d4-9f query_id=Q-772 upstream_timeout after 30000ms host=clickhouse-proxy-2
2026-03-16T08:41:12Z clickhouse-proxy WARN conn_pool exhausted waiting_for_conn=12
```
Looks like a recent config change increased max_parallel_queries which pushed too many heavy aggregations simultaneously. p95 latency on analytics cluster spiked at 08:38 UTC.
Lina: We rolled out config 87c9 last night which bumped max_parallel_queries=200 (was 80). Under sustained dashboard loads (many customers switching to last_7d) this saturates clickhouse and exhausts the connection pool. We also see OOMs on one proxy pod.
Ethan: Immediate options: 1) Roll back 87c9 -> 87c8 (restore previous concurrency) 2) Add a mitigation to route dashboard panel queries to /analytics/fast-agg (pre-aggregated endpoint) for heavy date ranges 3) Add a short-term circuit breaker per-org to limit concurrent agg queries.
Jordan: Priya — short-term workaround you can use: change panel timeframe to 'Last 1h' or enable 'use pre-aggregated data' toggle in panel settings. We'll attempt rollback now.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollback started for config 87c9 -> 87c8 by Lina at 2026-03-16T08:47:21Z
Lina: Rollback complete. Monitoring: error rate for analytics API dropped from 18% -> 0.3% in last 2 minutes, p95 latency returned to baseline. We'll keep an eye on the cluster and patch the connection pool logic.
Ethan: Followups: 1) Add a guard in agg-querier to reject queries with >1000 group keys for Last 7d default time windows 2) Add an organization-level fallback to fast-agg when group-by cardinality is high 3) Postmortem to add a canary test hitting heavy dashboards before config rollout.
Priya (Acme Inc.): Confirming dashboards load again and exec review can proceed. Thanks Jordan/Ethan/Lina!
Jordan: Great. I'll keep the ticket open until we have the postmortem and the safer rollout plan. :thumbsup: :relieved:
Ethan: Adding a quick note in the incident channel with the logs and rollback diff.
Lina: I'll follow up with a PR to add the safeguards and update runbook entries for concurrency rollouts.
Priya (Acme Inc.): Appreciate the fast turnaround.
